alignments.note: Explicit subject of the participial clause.

Participle rendered as a finite English predicate with its auxiliary; *up* is the phrasal particle of *build up* and stays with the verb under rule 44, since the clause's own object is what is built. Head on the lexical verb under rule 24.
Finite verb with its subject pronoun under rule 17; *together* completes the English phrasal verb of gathering, which rule 44 keeps with the verb (`כָּנַס` → *gather ... together*).
Anarthrous substantival participle: the supplied *the* joins its own unit under rule 46, headed on the word carrying the lexeme.
Nomen rectum takes the chain's *of* under rule 19.
